scope: Read-only clone of public repo at two immutable PR revisions; no source changes to upstream, no public review comments or GitHub App expansion.
preselection: Independently generate nested byte-marshaler YAML fragments and compare native decoding of stand-alone fragment vs embedded fragment. Include literal, folded, chomping, explicit-indent, unicode, plain and quoted controls across one through three levels of mapping/sequence wrappers.
generated_control: At least 2 plain/quoted non-block fragments, no artificial expectation requiring byte-identical formatting when semantic meaning preserved.
invariant: If standalone YAML fragment parses to one mapping, after nesting its byte-marshaler output must decode to the same mapping at the nested path. A failure can be invalid YAML, semantic drift, or unsupported input; type and parsed bytes must be recorded.
attributable_failure: Only label a newly introduced PR regression when original BASE passes a given frozen input and PR HEAD fails the same input, with original suite passing and no setup difference. BASE failure/HEAD success means PR repaired a behavior; both fail is inherited/residual and must not be blamed on PR.
prioritization: New valid-to-invalid YAML introduced by PR
New wrong decoded semantic value introduced by PR
Inherited failures requiring separate issue, not merge blocker without policy
outcome_contract: At most ONE consequential finding only if attributable+independently reproduced, with minimal native witness and smallest proposed action. Otherwise report no attributable finding and specify scope unknown.
experiment_arms: PR HEAD with original upstream CI
BASE vs HEAD with same fixed generated source-native corpus
Inherited defect control: '.nan' string fidelity (must not blame PR)
baseline_comparison: Strong conventional original native Go package suite; neither independent maintainer judgement nor coding-agent equal-information cost advantage is tested.
tests_author: Human-authored generic metamorphic oracle. Not an autonomous original claim extraction or repair method.
future_resolution: If native PR-introduced regression found, propose a minimal isolated patch and causal ablation on SHA; do not claim this phase passed until an actual run qualifies it.
